 Fifty Fifty adds Taipei to fan concert tour
 Published : Nov. 18, 2026 - 11:58:31
 Add The Korea Herald on Google
 Link copied!
 Hwang You-mee 
 Subscribe + 
 (Attract) 
 Girl group Fifty Fifty is planning a fan concert in Taipei, Taiwan, on Jan. 31, agency Attract announced Wednesday.
 Taipei is a recent addition to the group's first Asia fan concert tour, “Still LoBubble,” which began in Seoul in August. The four members will be meeting fans in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, and Singapore on Dec. 12 and 13, respectively, before heading to Taipei for the first time in approximately nine months.
 The tour title is inspired by “Like a Bubble,” the main track from the group's fourth EP “Imperfect - I’m Perfect” released in June. In September, it sang “Called it Love” for the webtoon “Serena,” its first soundtrack effort.
